description: You’ve probably seen bakers swirling hot cookies inside a bigger cutter to “fix” their shape… but honestly, who’s got time for that? I’d rather use a couple of rings than play cookie-shuffle with a tray of hot cookies. Perfect rounds, straight from the oven. 👉 Want the rings I use? Comment “cookiekit.” 👉 And if cookies are your thing, I just put together a new course that you might love - comment “cookielaunch” and I’ll send you the details. If you're seeing this on TikTok, visit the link in bio. AutoDM is only for Insta and FB!
